raw_html: [[Acid Arrow#Greater Acid Arrow|Greater Acid Arrow]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Acid Arrow#Greater Acid Arrow|Greater Acid Arrow]]:''' This bow coats your arrows in corrosive acid. A successful hit douses the target in acid causing an additional 12 to 30 damage after two seconds have passed. Each additional hit extends the duration of the acid damage by two seconds.
